tickerText: [TENNIS] Monday rankings reset: Alejandro Davidovich Fokina jumps to a career-high No. 13 after rallying past Rafael Jodar for his first ATP Masters 1000 crown in Shanghai, while Maja Chwalinska lifts her maiden WTA 1000 title in Wuhan • [SQUASH] PSA World Tour turns to Redwood City as the Gold-level Silicon Valley Open opens Tuesday, with Victor Crouin chasing a top-four push and Scott Arnold celebrating a maiden title at Australia’s Hilton Squash Open • [BADMINTON] VICTOR Denmark Open recap: An Se-young rallies from 11-5 down in the decider to beat Akane Yamaguchi for a record 47th title, and Alex Lanier becomes the first Frenchman to win Odense • [PICKLEBALL] PPA Virginia Beach Open wraps with Kate Fahey claiming women’s singles and mixed doubles gold and 18-year-old John Lucian Goins taking men’s singles on a windy Championship Sunday • [TABLE TENNIS] Félix Lebrun completes a golden double at the European Championships in Ljubljana as the ITTF-ATTU Asian Championships get underway Monday in Tashkent on the Road to Astana 2027

newsItems.title: Denmark Open Record Run
newsItems.excerpt: An Se-young stormed back from 11-5 down in the third to defeat Akane Yamaguchi 21-23, 21-14, 21-18 for her 47th career title—a new women’s singles record—while Alex Lanier beat Anders Antonsen to become the first Frenchman to win the Super 750 in Odense.

newsItems.title: Lebrun’s Ljubljana Double
newsItems.excerpt: France’s Félix Lebrun rallied from 3-2 down to beat Anton Källberg 4-3 in the European Championships final, adding men’s singles gold a day after he and Alexis defended the men’s doubles title in Arena Stožice.

newsItems.title: China Swing Champions
newsItems.excerpt: Davidovich Fokina saved his biggest comeback for last, edging Jodar 1-6, 7-6(5), 6-4 for a first Masters 1000 trophy in Shanghai, and Chwalinska turned a set deficit into a maiden WTA 1000 crown over Sonay Kartal in Wuhan.

newsItems.title: Fahey Doubles Up in VB
newsItems.excerpt: Kate Fahey swept women’s singles and mixed doubles at the Mojo Energy Pouches Virginia Beach Open, while John Lucian Goins capped the $1M-plus PPA stop with a straight-sets men’s singles win over Jaume Martinez Vich.
